Job Title: Embedded Platform Engineer
 Location: Bucharest, Romania
 Type: Permanent
 Our client are a Physical AI company looking for Engineers to work on-site in Bucharest.
 Key Responsibilities
 Develop and maintain platform firmware and board support packages (BSPs) for next-generation hardware.
 Write and optimize low-level device drivers (SPI, I2C, UART, GPIO, DMA) and integrate firmware with an RTOS.
 Execute board and SoC bring-up from power-on through functional firmware, implementing bootloaders, hardware abstraction layers, and power management.
 Debug hardware and firmware issues using lab instruments including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD.
 Optimize systems for performance, memory footprint, and real-time constraints while collaborating closely with silicon, hardware, and application teams.
 Requirements:
 BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science.
 7+ years of embedded firmware and driver development in C and C++.
 Strong understanding of microcontrollers/SoCs, memory, interrupts, and concurrency.
 Proven experience with device driver, peripheral, and board bring-up, alongside hands-on debugging with lab tools.
 Familiarity with RTOS and Linux kernel driver development.
 Desirables:
 Experience with ARM Cortex-M/R architectures.
 Background in developing bootloaders, secure boot, or OTA updates.
 Experience with Video RGB / RGB MIPI (CSI-2) camera interfaces and ISP pipelines.
 Background in robotics, sensors, or autonomous systems.
 If this sounds of interest, please reach out to daniel@microtech-global.com for more information
